headlines.title: Crown Castle vs. American Tower: Higher Yield or Better Dividend Growth
headlines.summary: One tower REIT hands retirees a bigger check today, while the other has a dividend with room to grow. Before choosing, weigh the payout cut, the debt load, and a trough year that both companies are betting on.

headlines.title: American Tower Stock And 2 AI Power Plays Worth Watching
headlines.summary: AI giants are back under the microscope, with talk of stricter rules on data centers and power use colliding with a sharp sell off in hyped AI stories. That mix is shaking confidence in growth darlings and quietly shifting attention toward the utilities and power infrastructure companies that keep data centers running. This article examines how that tension affects the market and highlights 3 U.S. stocks that are closely tied to the AI power build out.

headlines.title: If You Invested $25,000 in These 4 Dividend Stocks, Here’s What They’d Pay You
headlines.summary: A pipeline operator, a tower REIT, a chicken giant, and a healthcare conglomerate each get an equal slice of $25,000. One of them cut its dividend by more than 75% a decade ago, and another is about to split in two.

headlines.title: American Tower (AMT) International Revenue in Focus: Trends and Expectations
headlines.summary: Examine the evolution of American Tower's (AMT) overseas revenue trends and their effects on Wall Street's forecasts and the stock's prospects.

description: American Tower Corporation one of the largest global REITs, is a leading independent owner, operator and developer of multitenant communications real estate with a portfolio of over 147,000 communications sites and a highly interconnected footprint of U.S. data center facilities. American Tower Corporation was incorporated in 1995 in Delaware and is based in Massachusetts, Boston.
